name: Covista
outlook:
What Covista says to expect

  • Fiscal year 2027: revenueCovista raised its revenue guidance for fiscal year 2027 from a range of $2,050 million to $2,090 million, or approximately 5% to 7% growth year-over-year, to a range of $2,060 million to $2,095 million, or approximately 5.5% to 7% growth year-over-year.
  • Fiscal year 2027: adjusted earnings per shareCovista also raised its adjusted earnings per share guidance from a range of $8.90 to $9.15, or approximately 8% to 11% growth year-over-year, to a range of $9.00 to $9.20, or approximately 9% to 11.5% growth year-over-year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
